data.body: This workflow has no `concurrency:` group, unlike this repo's other per-resource workflows (`stale-issue-closer.yml`, `issue-triage.yml`), which scope a concurrency group to the resource being acted on. `synchronize` and `ready_for_review` can fire in quick succession for the same pull request (rapid force-pushes, or a re-run racing a fresh event), letting two job runs execute `pr_status_labels.py` concurrently against the same PR: both read the same label/event snapshot and independently call `applied_before`/apply the same adds/removes, wasting API calls and risking a stale ordering decision if one run's write lands between the other's read and write. Add a per-PR concurrency group so overlapping runs for the same pull request are serialized instead of racing.
